title: Maine School Safety Center
before:
Welcome to the Maine School Safety Center (MSSC) - Supporting a Restorative Culture of Care and safety in schools, the standard for all school safety and security matters. We are honored to serve the state of Maine and our schools while striving to make them as safe and secure as possible. Maine’s most precious resources are our students, school staff, and families, and we will work every day to ensure the level of physical and emotional safety that all parents desire for their children. 

 

About Us

Learn more about the MSSC

  • Maine Safe Schools Initiative
  • Where Have We Trained?
Services

The experts at MSSC provide training, guidance, and ongoing support for stakeholders across the state. Our services are designed to encompass a holistic approach to safety to ensure that all community partners work together to provide safe schools.

notes: Heading levels skip: jumps h1 to h5. Needs a person.

decisions.label: Write the email addresses the same way
decisions.why: 1 address is shown in whatever case it was typed in. The house form capitalises each name and leaves a middle initial in lower case — Robert.W.Susi@maine.gov → Robert.w.Susi@maine.gov. Only the first letter of each part changes, so a name that spells itself LaBreck keeps doing so.

decisions.label: Put the card titles on one level
decisions.why: 3 card titles are written at a level copied from an example rather than chosen — h5 on a page whose sections are h2. Only the number changes.

decisions.label: Set a job title the way the rest of the site does
decisions.why: 1 job title sits in plain text under the person's name, where 186 elsewhere on the site are in italics — so the same contact block is drawn two ways depending on the page, and the title runs into the name above it. The standard here is the site's own, not a preference: two thirds of these blocks already do it. No word changes.

decisions.label: Use this paragraph as the page description
decisions.why: It is the page’s own opening paragraph, moved into the banner rather than rewritten.
